abstract: Cytological characteristics of clear cell carcinoma (CCC) and yolk sac tumor (YST) of the ovary were examined and compared. Indices for differential diagnosis of these two histologically similar but biologically different tumors were analyzed based on cytological features of the tumor cells. The main results obtained were from three cases of CCC and one case of YST who underwent imprint smear or similar examinations. Seventeen cases of CCC and two of YST with positive cytology results, mainly obtained from ascites samples, were also examined. Cytological characteristics of CCC compared to those of YST were: more marked cohesiveness of tumor cells with less-marked pleomorphism, well-preserved cell borders, fine vesicular cytoplasm, evenly thickened nuclear membrane, and fewer nucleoli and multinucleated giant cells in number. Cells with large cytoplasmic vacuolation were infrequent, and hobnail-shaped tumor cells were rather few in number in CCC cases examined. On the other hand, in the case of YST, cells were more dyscohesive, with marked cellular pleomorphism, usually faint cell borders, no thickening of nuclear membrane and occasional presence of nuclear grooves. The "naked" cells were commonly observed. Further, nucleoli were frequently numerous in number, and multinucleated giant cells were frequently found which showed marked cellular and nuclear atypism. These characteristics found mainly in imprint smears were also relatively well preserved in specimens obtained from ascites or other metastatic sites. These findings indicate that detailed cytological examination can provide a means for differential diagnosis of CCC and YST, supplementing other clinical information.
abstract_ja: 明細胞癌（CCC）と卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST）の細胞学的特徴を検討し比較した。組織学的に類似しているが生物学的に異なるこれら2つの腫瘍を鑑別するための指標を、腫瘍細胞の細胞学的特徴に基づいて分析した。主な結果は、イムプリントスメアなどの検査を受けた明細胞癌3例と卵黄嚢腫瘍1例の症例から得られた。また、主に腹水検体から細胞診陽性となった明細胞癌17例と卵黄嚢腫瘍2例も検討した。明細胞癌の細胞学的特徴は卵黄嚢腫瘍と比較して、腫瘍細胞の結合性がより顕著で、多形性は軽度、細胞境界は保たれ、細胞質は微細な空胞状を呈し、核膜は均一に肥厚し、核小体や多核巨細胞は少ないものであった。大きな細胞質空胞を有する細胞は稀で、検討した明細胞癌例ではhobnail様の腫瘍細胞もごく少数であった。一方、卵黄嚢腫瘍では、細胞の結合性が低く、顕著な細胞多形性を示し、細胞境界は不明瞭で、核膜の肥厚はなく、時に核溝を認めた。「裸核状」の細胞がしばしば観察された。さらに、核小体が多数認められることが多く、著明な細胞および核の異型性を示す多核巨細胞がしばしば認められた。主にイムプリントスメアで認められたこれらの特徴は、腹水やその他の転移部位から得られた検体でも比較的よく保存されていた。これらの所見は、詳細な細胞学的検査が、他の臨床情報を補完しながら明細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の鑑別診断に役立つことを示している。
